EOSS (Shanghai) Building Systems Co., Ltd.
EOSS (Shanghai) Building Systems Co., Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Shandong Huajian Aluminium Group—one of China’s leading manufacturers of architectural aluminium systems.

With Shanghai as its strategic hub, EOSS is actively expanding into international markets, particularly Australia and New Zealand, offering full-spectrum support in system development, product testing, regulatory compliance, and technical services.
EOSS provides integrated system solutions for energy-efficient buildings, covering:
Façade system design and consultation Product development and supply Technical support for high-spec residential and commercial projects
Our goal is to support architects, developers, and contractors in delivering smarter, greener buildings through durable, high-performance system products.

Rooted in China, EOSS is committed to delivering cutting-edge aluminium building systems to global markets. Our solutions are engineered for performance, sustainability, and long-term value in diverse climate zones and architectural styles.
